title: Stealing and Sharing
description: Share food with your friends or steal their equipped items
body:
Server-side mod that enables you to steal items from players, and share them.

## Features

* Feed a player food by right-clicking while holding food.
* Steal a player's armour by right-clicking on them with an empty hand (removes the top piece first).
* Equip armour on another player by right-clicking on them while holding a piece of armour (does not work if they are wearing armour).
* Steal an item from a player's hand by shift+right-clicking on them with an empty hand.
* Configurable via gamerules (all under the namespace `stealing-and-sharing`).

## Support
You can join the [Goobercorp Discord](https://discord.gg/A2FEXREAtQ) for support. You may also file bugs on the [bug tracker](https://codeberg.org/girlonthenet/stealing-and-sharing/issues).
